info.name: Phase 3 - Approval Workflow
info.description:
Comprehensive testing for Phase 3: Workflow State Machine, Content Versioning, Dashboard Analytics, and Notifications

**Prerequisites:**
- Phase 1 completed (users and tokens)
- Phase 2 completed (pages and sections created)
- Backend server running

**Test Coverage:**
- Complete workflow lifecycle (draft → published)
- State transition validation
- Content versioning and comparison
- Dashboard metrics and analytics
- Notification system

**Expected Runtime:** ~3 minutes
